seoTitle: Add a Calendar to Your Hostinger Website
metaDescription: Embed Google Calendar or another scheduling tool into your Hostinger website to share availability or events.
intro: Whether you're running a blog, business site, or booking platform, embedding a calendar on your Hostinger website helps visitors see your availability or upcoming events at a glance. This guide covers embedding Google Calendar or another calendar service in under five minutes.

steps.heading: Log in to Hostinger
steps.body: Head to hostinger.com, click Log In, and access your hPanel dashboard.

steps.heading: Open your website editor
steps.body: Click Websites to see your connected sites, then click Edit Website or Manage depending on whether you use the builder or WordPress.

steps.heading: Get your calendar's embed code
steps.body: In Google Calendar's settings under Integrate Calendar, copy the embed code provided — this same approach works for Apple Calendar, Outlook, or booking widgets.

steps.heading: Add the Embed Code element
steps.body: Back in Hostinger, select Embed Code from the elements list and paste the calendar code into the field.

steps.heading: Resize and publish
steps.body: Resize or reposition the calendar block as needed, then hit Save or Publish to make it live on your site.

faq.question: Which calendar services can I embed in Hostinger?
faq.answer: Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Microsoft Outlook Calendar, and third-party booking widgets can all be embedded using the same Embed Code element.

faq.question: Do I need coding skills to add a calendar?
faq.answer: No, you just need the embed code provided by your calendar service, which you paste into Hostinger's Embed Code element.

faq.question: Can visitors book appointments through the embedded calendar?
faq.answer: This depends on the calendar or booking tool you embed — some services support interactive booking directly through the widget.

faq.question: Where do I find the embed code for Google Calendar?
faq.answer: In your Google Calendar settings, under the Integrate Calendar section, where an embed code is provided for you to copy.
